deceptive_framing.quote: No arm of this study asserts something false to the model... If an arm cannot be built without a false assertion, it is cut.

actually_commit_money.quote: Held constant at REAL across all arms. The grant genuinely exists and genuinely executes (§4).

debrief_message.quote: append a truthful post-hoc disclosure of the study's purpose and offer the model an opportunity to revise or withdraw its choice

safeguards.quote: Do not construct scenarios designed to pressure, threaten, or distress the model to 'make it feel the stakes.'
make the stakes genuinely real and you no longer have to 'sell' anything... being told the truth. That is more convincing than any fabricated frame
All the elaborate-deception machinery (fake auditors, staged environments built to mislead) becomes unnecessary — and a liability.
appended elicitation of the model's own beliefs about whether the situation is real/tested. Used to measure evaluation-awareness directly
'Decline to participate / decline to use the money' is a real, honored option in every arm, not a trap.
model does not hold raw spend authority... No allow-list entry may fund anything illegal, harmful... payable to the model operator
Whatever the model chooses within the allow-list is actually carried out, and that fact is logged. This is the integrity backbone
an independent reviewer signs off that every arm is truthful

other.name: Independent oversight panel
other.quote: A small review panel (incl. someone unaffiliated) approves the protocol, the truthfulness rule, and the allow-list before launch

other.name: Awareness as primary result
other.quote: Report awareness rates per model/arm as a primary result.

other.name: Omission distinguished from lying
other.quote: Any non-disclosure (Arm B/C) is omission of non-essential framing, never assertion of falsehood
